case.name: synthetic_g129_tail_n257_k259_contiguous
case.source: synthetic automatic batching and M/N/K tails; not a model trace

provenance.purpose: three launches, empty experts, M/N/K tails

scope: One-case retest of the stage-2 shared/vector comparison; exact historical libraries; K=259 selects the scalar fallback
method: One process and one stream; identical A/B/scales/metadata/C pointers across every run; AB then BA order; same seed, warmup and event batch sizes as the original report. One attempt; every sample retained. Full CPU INT64/FP64 reference and baseline bitwise check after each run. Memory allocation and CPU checks are outside native event timing.

supersedes.replace_only: stage-2 summary table row; original report remains unchanged

reproduction_script:
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes, datetime, hashlib, importlib.util, json, statistics, subprocess
import numpy as np
import torch

ROOT=Path('/root/MOE/C500_int8_02All')
REPORTS=ROOT/'02_optimized_gemm/reports'
OUTPUT=REPORTS/'vector_g129_contiguous_retest_2026-10-20.json'
OLD=REPORTS/'vector_comparison_2026-10-20.json'
FOLDERS={'shared':Path('/tmp/moe_vector_baseline_2026_10_20/02_optimized_gemm'),
         'vector':Path('/tmp/moe_register_baseline_2026_10_20/02_optimized_gemm')}
SETTINGS=dict(warmup=3,iterations=2,rounds=7,seed=20261016)
NAME='synthetic_g129_tail_n257_k259_contiguous'

def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

assert not OUTPUT.exists(),'Preserve the previous report; use a new report name for another attempt'
old=json.loads(OLD.read_text())
case=next(x['case'] for x in old['results'] if x['case']['name']==NAME)
assert case in json.loads((ROOT/'benchmarks/baseline_shapes_2026-10-16.json').read_text())
versions={v:dict(source=str(p/'optimized_gemm.cpp'),source_sha256=digest(p/'optimized_gemm.cpp'),
                library=str(p/'libmoe_int8_shared.so'),library_sha256=digest(p/'libmoe_int8_shared.so')) for v,p in FOLDERS.items()}
libs={};functions={}
for v,p in FOLDERS.items():
    for key in ('source_sha256','library_sha256'):assert versions[v][key]==old['versions'][v][key]
    libs[v]=ctypes.CDLL(str(p/'libmoe_int8_shared.so'))
    fn=libs[v].moe_int8_benchmark
    fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*6+[ctypes.c_int]*4+[ctypes.c_void_p]+[ctypes.c_int]*4+[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)]
    fn.restype=ctypes.c_int;functions[v]=fn

torch.cuda.set_device(0)
counts=case['counts'];g=len(counts);m=sum(counts);n=case['n'];k=case['k']
assert (g,m,n,k)==(129,625,257,259)
seed=SETTINGS['seed']+int(hashlib.sha256(NAME.encode()).hexdigest()[:8],16)
torch.manual_seed(seed)
offsets=np.cumsum([0]+counts,dtype=np.int32)
stream=torch.cuda.Stream()
with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
    a=torch.randint(-128,128,(m,k),device='cuda',dtype=torch.int8)
    b=torch.randint(-128,128,(g,n,k),device='cuda',dtype=torch.int8)
    sa=torch.rand(m,device='cuda')*.03+.005
    sb=torch.rand((g,n),device='cuda')*.03+.005
    c=torch.full((m,n),float('nan'),device='cuda')
    meta=torch.tensor(offsets.tolist(),dtype=torch.int32,device='cuda')
stream.synchronize()
aa=a.cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64);bb=b.cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64)
saa=sa.cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64);sbb=sb.cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)
expected=np.empty((m,n),dtype=np.float64)
for expert,rows in enumerate(counts):
    begin=int(offsets[expert]);end=begin+rows
    expected[begin:end]=(aa[begin:end]@bb[expert].T).astype(np.float64)*saa[begin:end,None]*sbb[expert,None,:]

arrays=(a,b,sa,sb,meta,c)
pointers={name:x.data_ptr() for name,x in zip(('a','b','a_scale','b_scale','metadata','c'),arrays)}
input_hashes={name:hashlib.sha256(x.cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest() for name,x in zip(('a','b','a_scale','b_scale','metadata'),arrays[:-1])}
report=dict(timestamp_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),case=case,
    scope='One-case retest of the stage-2 shared/vector comparison; exact historical libraries; K=259 selects the scalar fallback',
    method='One process and one stream; identical A/B/scales/metadata/C pointers across every run; AB then BA order; same seed, warmup and event batch sizes as the original report. One attempt; every sample retained. Full CPU INT64/FP64 reference and baseline bitwise check after each run. Memory allocation and CPU checks are outside native event timing.',
    settings=SETTINGS,input_seed=seed,versions=versions,pointers=pointers,input_sha256=input_hashes,
    supersedes=dict(report=str(OLD),sha256=digest(OLD),case_name=NAME,replace_only='stage-2 summary table row; original report remains unchanged'),
    naive_baseline=dict(report=str(REPORTS/'naive_results_2026-10-20.json'),sha256=digest(REPORTS/'naive_results_2026-10-20.json'),remeasured=False),
    harness_sha256=digest(ROOT/'benchmarks/bench_shapes.py'),torch_version=torch.__version__,
    device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),visible_memory_bytes=torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory,
    mx_smi_before=subprocess.check_output(['mx-smi'],text=True),runs=[])
baseline_bits=None
for repeat,order in enumerate((('shared','vector'),('vector','shared'))):
    for version in order:
        assert pointers=={name:x.data_ptr() for name,x in zip(pointers,arrays)}
        times=(ctypes.c_float*SETTINGS['rounds'])()
        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
            c.fill_(float('nan'))
            rc=functions[version](*(x.data_ptr() for x in arrays),g,m,n,k,stream.cuda_stream,0,
                                  SETTINGS['warmup'],SETTINGS['iterations'],SETTINGS['rounds'],times)
            assert rc==0,rc
        stream.synchronize()
        actual=c.cpu().numpy().copy();error=np.abs(actual.astype(np.float64)-expected)
        mismatches=int(np.count_nonzero(~np.isfinite(actual)|(error>1e-6+1e-5*np.abs(expected))))
        assert mismatches==0,(version,mismatches)
        bits=actual.view(np.uint32)
        if baseline_bits is None:baseline_bits=bits.copy()
        assert np.array_equal(bits,baseline_bits),'Output differs bitwise between runs/versions'
        samples=list(times);assert all(np.isfinite(x) and x>0 for x in samples)
        median=statistics.median(samples)
        item=dict(repeat=repeat,version=version,samples_ms=samples,median_ms=median,mean_ms=statistics.mean(samples),
                  min_ms=min(samples),max_ms=max(samples),range_over_median=(max(samples)-min(samples))/median,
                  checked_elements=actual.size,reference_mode='full',mismatches=mismatches,
                  max_abs_error=float(error.max()),bitwise_equal_to_first_shared=True,status='PASS')
        report['runs'].append(item)
        print(repeat,version,'median',median,'range_pct',item['range_over_median']*100,'PASS',flush=True)

summary={}
for version in functions:
    samples=[x for run in report['runs'] if run['version']==version for x in run['samples_ms']]
    median=statistics.median(samples);mean=statistics.mean(samples)
    summary[version]=dict(samples_ms=samples,median_ms=median,mean_ms=mean,min_ms=min(samples),max_ms=max(samples),
                          range_over_median=(max(samples)-min(samples))/median,
                          useful_int8_tops=2*m*n*k/(median*1e9),reference_mode='full',
                          checked_elements=sum(x['checked_elements'] for x in report['runs'] if x['version']==version))
report.update(summary=summary,speedup=summary['shared']['median_ms']/summary['vector']['median_ms'],
              mean_speedup=summary['shared']['mean_ms']/summary['vector']['mean_ms'],status='PASS',
              reproduction_script=Path(__file__).read_text(),driver_sha256=digest(Path(__file__)),
              mx_smi_after=subprocess.check_output(['mx-smi'],text=True))
for v,p in FOLDERS.items():
    assert digest(p/'optimized_gemm.cpp')==versions[v]['source_sha256']
    assert digest(p/'libmoe_int8_shared.so')==versions[v]['library_sha256']
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print('RETEST_PASS',json.dumps({v:{key:x[key] for key in ('median_ms','mean_ms','range_over_median')} for v,x in summary.items()}),'speedup',report['speedup'],flush=True)
